elements.text: How are decisions made in the EU
The EU's standard decision-making procedure is known as the Ordinary Legislative Procedure (ex 'codecision'):
The European Commission drafts and implements EU legislation.
Both the European Parliament (directly elected) and the EU Council (28 governments) has to approve EU legislation.
